B.text: If each bold percentage printed directly above a source bar is the authoritative reported clean-grid share, the source with the greatest printed percentage is the largest contribution source; the task routes that source to priority contribution review.
B.conditions: Applies only if the percentage inscriptions are authoritative despite any inconsistency with bar heights.
